senses.gloss: m. (גדש) the heap, the top over the level of a dry measure.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 62b:2">Zeb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>כמחק ג׳ סאה</he> as thick as the instrument for striking off the top of a S’ah.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 9:5">Men. IX, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 90a:3">90ᵃ</cite>) <he>היה גוֹדְשָׁהּ לתוכה</he> (Var. <he>גָדְשָׁהּ</he>) its heap was added to the measure, i.e. the additional quantity forming the top of other measures, was contained in the Highpriest’s measure which was so much larger.
